extends RefCounted
# Test-only DTO fixtures, not an alternative production simulation/validator.
const ROOT := "res://tests/fixtures/evolution_supply/"
func _read(name: String) -> Dictionary:
	return JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ROOT+name))
func run_state(_case_id: String = "initial") -> Dictionary:
	return _read("run_v2.json")
func game_save(_case_id: String = "initial") -> Dictionary:
	return _read("game_save_v2.json")
func progression_view(case_id: String) -> Dictionary:
	return _read("progression_views.json").get(case_id,{}).duplicate(true)
func supply_view(case_id: String) -> Dictionary:
	return _read("supply_views.json").get(case_id,{}).duplicate(true)
func attack_events(case_id: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
	result.assign(_read("attack_events.json").get(case_id,[]))
	return result
func make_run(_chapter: Dictionary, seed: int, config: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var result := run_state()
	result.seed = seed
	result.run_config = config.duplicate(true)
	result.run_id = config.run_id
	result.run_serial = config.run_serial
	return result
func validate_checkpoint(value: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	# Only E's isolated file/transaction tests may inject this shape-only fake.
	if value.get("schema_version") != 2 or not value.get("run_id") is String or not value.get("player") is Dictionary:
		return {"ok":false,"error_code":"invalid_snapshot"}
	return {"ok":true,"state":value.duplicate(true)}
